name: YITAMOTOR Floor Mats Compatible with 2015-2022 Chevy Colorado Crew Cab/GMC Canyon Crew Cab, Custom Fit Floor Liners, 1st & 2nd Row All Weather Protection, Black
fitment:
Compatible for 2015-2022 Chevy Colorado Crew Cab
Compatible for 2015-2022 GMC Canyon Crew Cab
Does not fit Extended Cab
Not designed for models equipped with vinyl flooring
For your safety, professional installation is highly recommended.
warnings: 官网质保弹窗引用其他品牌
description:
It is our honor to offer the highest quality floor mats at extremely reasonable prices, therefore, every item surpasses your expectations. We want to make "YOU" a happy customer! Our goal is to offer our customers excellent products with excellent value. We will provide you the best innovative, quality products & professional services at competitive prices.
Fitment
Compatible for 2015-2022 Chevy Colorado Crew Cab
Compatible for 2015-2022 GMC Canyon Crew Cab
Does not fit Extended Cab
Not designed for models equipped with vinyl flooring
For your safety, professional installation is highly recommended.
Features
Custom Fit: these floor mats are compatible with 2015-2022 chevy colorado crew cab/gmc canyon crew cab, 3d laser scanning technology giving the front and back fully protection. not for vehicles with vinyl floors. please take out old floor mats before installing new floor liners.
Built For Durability: our floor liners are made with non-toxic and odorless tpe material, ensures you are safe even in extreme hot weather, contains no latex, cadmium, lead or any harmful pvc’s. high tensity tpe material not only provide excellent touch feeling and extreme wear-resistance, but also remains flexible under extreme cold weather.
All Season Protection & Non-Slip: unique designed channels and raised edge can effectively trap the liquid, snow, sand etc. and keep your car and shoes clean. the hooks can effectively prevent the mats from slipping even when wet, available for children and aged person.
Easy To Clean the textured skid-resistant surface is easily cleaned. no need the cumbersome vacuum cleaner or harsh chemicals. simply shake them out or spray them down with a hose.
Why Choose Yitamotor: Our floor mats are processed with advanced technology, rendering tailored protection and all-weather guard to your vehicle

specifications.Special features: Solid, easy to install, easy to clean, precision 3d laser measured, perfect fit, waterproof, anti-slip, durable, non-toxic tpe material, all-weather protection
